description: Implementation of the rrc_ue_impl class handling RRC UE procedures, including security context, SRB creation, handover, and transaction management in a 5G NR RRC context.

classes.name: rrc_ue_impl
classes.description: Class implementing UE-specific RRC procedures, including security, SRB management, handover, and transaction control.

methods.name: create_srb
methods.description: Creates a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) with specified parameters, including security configuration.

methods.name: get_srbs
methods.description: Returns a list of SRB IDs currently associated with the UE.

methods.name: get_rrc_state
methods.description: Returns the current RRC state of the UE.

methods.name: cancel_handover_reconfiguration_transaction
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing handover reconfiguration transaction based on transaction ID.

methods.name: cancel_all_transactions
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing RRC transactions for the UE.

methods.name: update_c_rnti
methods.description: Updates the C-RNTI (Cell Radio Network Temporary Identifier) for the UE.

methods.name: update_cell_group_config
methods.description: Updates the cell group configuration data.

methods.name: on_new_as_security_context
methods.description: Configures security for the UE's SRB1 based on the latest security context.

methods.name: get_packed_handover_preparation_message
methods.description: Generates and returns a packed handover preparation message based on UE capabilities.

methods.name: on_ue_release_required
methods.description: Handles UE release requests, scheduling asynchronous cleanup tasks.
